text: Without nonlinear activations, the product of all the layer weight matrices W^(L)...W^(1) collapses to a single ___ matrix (W_eff), so the network has the expressivity of just one layer.
explanation: With f equal to the identity, W^(L)...W^(1) equals a single effective matrix W_eff, so depth adds no expressivity; the nonlinearity is what gives a deep network its power.
